children: Overview
US residential controls maker's Q3 revenue rose 3% yr/yr
Standalone adjusted diluted EPS for Q3 rose 8% yr/yr
Company repaid $1.1 bln of gross debt following ADI spin-off
Outlook
Resideo sees Q4 2026 revenue between $710 mln and $730 mln
Company expects full-year 2026 revenue of $2,927 mln to $2,947 mln
Resideo expects at least $165 mln cash provided by operating activities for 2026
Result Drivers
NON-OEM GROWTH - Revenue excluding OEM Security rose 6% yr/yr, driven by customer demand and pricing across all sales channels and product categories
OEM SECURITY DECLINE - OEM Security revenue fell 34% yr/yr due to reduced volumes from a large customer, as expected

GROSS MARGIN EXPANSION - Gross margin improved for the 14th consecutive qtr, helped by price increases, operational efficiencies, and tariff refunds, partly offset by unfavorable product mix and inflation
